name: Nimble Momonga
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, gain 1000 Life Points. You can also Special Summon any number of "Nimble Momongas" from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

name: Axe of Despair
extDescription: The equipped monster gains 1000 ATK. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, you can Tribute 1 monster to return this card to the top of the Deck.

name: Enemy Controller
extDescription:

- Tribute 1 monster. Select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls. Take control of it until the End Phase.

name: Lightning Vortex
extDescription: Discard 1 card. Destroy all face-up monsters your opponent controls.
